description: This file defines the 'MenuItem' entity class for the OrangeHRM project, including its properties, getters, and setters, and ORM mapping annotations for database interaction.

classes.name: MenuItem
classes.description: A class representing a menu item entity in the OrangeHRM system with properties for menu hierarchy, status, associated screen, and additional parameters.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the menu item.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the ID for the menu item.

methods.name: getParent
methods.description: Returns the parent menu item, if any.

methods.name: getOrderHint
methods.description: Returns the order hint for display sorting.

methods.name: getStatus
methods.description: Returns the status (active/inactive) of the menu item.

methods.name: setStatus
methods.description: Sets the status of the menu item.

methods.name: getScreen
methods.description: Retrieves the associated screen entity, if any.

methods.name: getAdditionalParams
methods.description: Returns any additional parameters stored as an array.
